title: Autumn Junk Journal Kit Printable, Fall Vintage Botanical Journal Pages, Envelopes, Pockets, Journaling Cards, Dark Academia Ephemera
description:
Dreaming of a cozy autumn junk journal full of maple leaves, moths, mushrooms and old letters? The Ember & Oak Junk Journal Kit gives you everything to build one, all designed to match.

WHO IT'S FOR
Junk journalers, scrapbookers and paper crafters who love vintage botanicals, dark academia and warm fall colors.

WHAT YOU GET: 52 printable pages in US Letter and A4, 124 pieces in total
1. 20 full-page papers: botanicals, ledger and sheet music, owl moon, fern hollow, damask, plaid and 2 solids
2. 6 sheets of cut-apart ephemera: 18 pieces in 14 illustrated designs (oak, maple, fern, mushrooms, moth, owl, crow, key, apothecary bottle, wreath and more)
3. 12 envelope and pocket templates (20 pieces): 6 envelopes in 3 shapes, 4 library card pockets, 2 tuck-in page pockets, 4 tall tags, 4 belly bands
4. 62 journaling cards: 54 cards 2.5 x 3.5 in (27 illustrated, 27 lined) and 8 lined cards 3 x 4 in
5. 4 full-page lined journaling pages
6. 2 START HERE pages with printing tips

You receive 4 PDF files: Part 1 (papers) and Part 2 (ephemera, envelopes, pockets, cards and pages), each in US Letter and in A4. High resolution, ready to print.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- One coordinated palette of rust, ochre, sage and sepia, so every page goes together
- Templates are ready to cut: solid line to cut, dashed line to fold
- Cards print at their true size on both paper sizes
- Saves you money compared with buying the paper pack, envelopes and cards separately

HOW IT WORKS
1. Purchase and download the files from the Purchases section of your Etsy account (use a web browser; the Etsy app does not download digital files)
2. Open the PDF that matches your paper: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) or A4
3. Print at 100% / Actual size on matte paper or light cardstock
4. Cut, fold, layer and create

GOOD TO KNOW
- This is a digital download: nothing is shipped
- Colors may vary slightly between screens and printers
- Personal use and physical handmade items you sell (journals, cards, scrapbooks) are welcome; reselling or sharing the digital files is not
- Some of the artwork was created with the help of AI tools, then selected and finished by hand
- Because this is a digital product, returns are not accepted. If anything is wrong with your files, message me and I'll make it right!

Part of the Ember & Oak autumn collection by Oakfold. Every piece is designed to match.
